svg.title: Плавание на спине — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Backstroke swimming, oblique elevated view of full body. Face UP visible both phases, head floating, legs long with narrow alternating flutter kicks. LEFT one straight arm coming out of water above shoulder, opposite arm along torso. RIGHT same athlete with the other arm extended overhead toward water while first sweeps under water along torso. Modest jammer swim shorts, sparse water lines. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
